authorityRules: Bind the exact authenticated input payload and derived qualificationRef. This receipt is a distinct native qualification signature, never an I09 overlay, site signature, secret observation, settings approval or general business-transition receipt.

receiptDocumentDigest authenticates RFC8785 JSON of the complete normative QUALITY/schemas/qualification-receipt.schema.json document. signatureEnvelope contains only the fixed format COSE_Sign1, algorithm ES256, curve P-256, hash SHA-256 and canonicalization PC-CBOR-1 descriptor; actual payload/COSE/signature bytes and their digests are stored alongside, never in this preimage.

The document uses the exact C17 profileId/profileVersion/schemaVersion; authorityId, signerKeyId, keyEpoch, qualificationRef, issuedAt and expiresAt must equal the signed map. All subjectArtifactDigest/buildDigest/sourceTreeDigest and environment/workload identities must equal the input; mandatory topology/resource/corpus/harness/toolchain/raw-evidence identities, normalizedResults, reviewerAttestation, limitations, exclusions, claimCeilingIds, trustRegistryRef and revocationRef remain substantive mandatory inputs, not placeholder hashes.

EXECUTED_PASS is legal only after actual schema/digest/subject identity/independence/eligibility/expected result/negative control/failure-mode gates. The independently identified reviewer must not author the changed subject or harness; signer principal must be distinct from implementation and generator principals. A receipt digest, caller pass flag or signature alone cannot prove those facts.

keysetPayloadDigest and revocationPayloadDigest retain exact authority at issuance. Every use independently checks freshly installed root-authenticated current state and exact key epoch. Rotation preserves historical validity unless covered by revocation; expiry, suspension, revoked covered epoch, missing current state or an out-of-scope claim makes the input UNQUALIFIED, never warning-only.

Implements only an internal adapter contract for authenticated operations qualification under the adopted ASTRA-14/16 plan. The delivered C17 authority remains DESIGNED_NOT_CONSTITUTED with keys UNPROVISIONED; local external test signers prove adapter behavior only. No production qualification, certification, SLO/SLA or product claim promotion follows.

Use existing PC-CBOR-1 and COSE_Sign1 ES256/P-256/SHA-256 profile 2, exact schema definition/AAD/purpose and exact original bytes. The verifier rejects unknown/duplicate/noncanonical fields, malformed identities, type coercion, key/purpose substitution, mutable references and ambiguous signature outcomes. Retain first failures and originals.

For JSON document digest preimages use RFC8785 with duplicate-key/NFC rejection and exact closed schemas. Every fixed signatureEnvelope descriptor is exactly {format:COSE_Sign1,algorithm:ES256,curve:P-256,hash:SHA-256,canonicalization:PC-CBOR-1}. ISO times are canonical UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ representing the exact signed millisecond field. Document digest fields use the prefix-free form required by C17; signed H32 claims use the canonical sha256: representation.

Privileged durable installation, RLS/tenant context, independent issuer eligibility, actual execution/reviewer evidence, current keyset/revocation checks and the exact generation binding remain separate required owners. These public wire declarations do not create tables, grants, runtime APIs, qualification success, effective configuration or any signing/send effect.

Bound and copy document bytes before parsing: input payload 65536 bytes, receipt document 524288 bytes, keyset document 131072 bytes and revocation document 4194304 bytes maximum. Unknown fields, duplicate keys, non-NFC strings, malformed entries and partial snapshots fail closed before database allocation.

environmentIdentityDigest and workloadIdentityDigest in the input are SHA-256 of RFC8785 JSON of the corresponding complete receipt document identity objects. The consumer compares actual authoritative current subject/workload/environment inputs, not caller-selected digest strings. The receipt document has exactly the properties declared by the normative C17 receipt schema; all are required.
